column1: # Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition 1.1.2 (SDK 9.3.1, Monolith engine, NVN).
# See README.md for the measured bring-up and validation status.

# PEANUTS: Android: the game times its own 30 fps (33.23 ms) while presenting at interval 1, which beats against the panel (AYN Thor 117.84 Hz: 4 refreshes = 33.94 ms): 1 frame in ~7 stayed 5 refreshes (SurfaceFlinger, 2026-11-25). The limiter ticks in whole panel refreshes: 10,809 of 10,809 frames at 4 over six minutes (README)

# PEANUTS: Android: about one boot in four corrupted the heap 1-4 s into nnMain (README); the game takes two threads of one core never running at the same moment: 0 of 60 boots crashed with this (the first 20 s)
# Startup requests a 0xC9400000-byte heap; the reservation leaves 3328 MB for it.
# The NPDM declares no system resource; virtual address memory is disabled.
